title: README + GitHub Pages CI action to publish docs/site
description: Build and deploy the Flash 8 editor web app to GitHub Pages so users can open it in a browser. The app already has a browser build target (pnpm dev:browser runs it). Tasks: (1) check if there is a pnpm build:browser or similar production build script — if not, add one (Vite build targeting the browser, output to dist/); (2) create .github/workflows/pages.yml that on push to main: installs deps, builds the browser bundle, deploys dist/ to GitHub Pages using actions/upload-pages-artifact + actions/deploy-pages; (3) optionally add a top-level README.md with a link to the live app URL and a brief description. Check package.json scripts and vite.config files for the correct build command.
